_doc: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE RULES for the test suite. Every value is an illustration chosen so the fixtures have round numbers; none is a recommendation. A real book keeps its own numbers here: every numeric rule the tools enforce is read from this file.

covered_call_closer.rounding_note: The fraction is a ceiling on what the closer pays, so it never rounds below fraction × fill.
covered_call_closer.basis: actual fill, or the blended fill if the block was built in more than one order

option_ticks.status: penny under $3.00, nickel at or above; check the instrument's own tick rules

delta_bands._status: example bands; if the breakeven floor and the band conflict, the floor wins and delta goes lower

graded_clearance.interpretation: Depth underwater = (basis - spot) / basis. Clearance = (strike - breakeven after this credit) / that breakeven. Depth <= near_basis_depth requires near_basis_min (warns below near_basis_target); depth >= deep_depth requires deep_min; linear in between.

min_open_interest.interpretation: An illustrative open-interest floor for a small exit.

quote_window.interpretation: Opening-bell and after-hours quotes are not prices; the opening-bell length is an example.

cooldown.blocks: new risk (new underlyings, new capital, size increases); never re-covering held shares, closing, or assignment

max_risk.caps_apply_to: defined-risk structures only; wheel tickets state max loss in $ and % of pool without a cap
